text: “AI-Based Beam Management for FR3 FDD MIMO via Online Channel Synthesis” has been accepted to IEEE JSAC.
Hyung-Joo Moon won first place in the IEEE ComSoc Four-Minute Competition (1st out of 55).
“MAP-X: Massive Field Data Processing for Real-Time Wide-Area Mapping Using High-Altitude Platforms with MIMO” has been accepted to IEEE TWC.
“AI-Enhanced Wide-Area Data Imaging via Massive Non-Orthogonal Direct Device-to-HAPS Transmission” has been accepted to IEEE COMMAG.
“A Generalized Pointing Error Model for FSO Links with Fixed-Wing UAVs for 6G: Analysis and Trajectory Optimization” has been accepted to IEEE TWC.
“Cooperative Ground-Satellite Scheduling and Power Allocation for Urban Air Mobility Networks” has been accepted to IEEE JSAC.
Hyung-Joo Moon began a visiting research appointment at UC San Diego.
Hyung-Joo Moon won the Bronze Prize at the Samsung Humantech Paper Award.
“Pointing-and-Acquisition for Optical Wireless in 6G: From Algorithms to Performance Evaluation” has been accepted to IEEE COMMAG.
“Performance Analysis of Passive Retro-Reflector Based Tracking in Free-Space Optical Communications With Pointing Errors” has been accepted to IEEE TVT.
“RF Lens Antenna Array-based One-Shot Coarse Pointing for Hybrid RF/FSO Communications” has been accepted to IEEE WCL.
